title: QED-Nano: Teaching a Tiny Model to Prove Hard Theorems
authors_zh: LM-Provers、Yuxiao Qu、Amrith Setlur、Jasper Dekoninck、Edward Beeching、Jia Li、Ian Wu、Lewis Tunstall、Aviral Kumar
paper_type_zh: 自然语言定理证明模型报告、rubric 奖励配方与统计型 rollout 数据发布
best_for_zh: 研究 rollout 数据、Olympiad proof RL、LLM judge 奖励、Reasoning Cache、test-time compute 与数据发布可审计性的读者
one_line: QED-Nano couples 128-attempt difficulty statistics, 16-rollout rubric-reward GRPO, and three-turn Reasoning-Cache training, while FineProofs-RL releases prompts, rubrics, and score arrays but not the proofs behind them.
QED-Nano 将每题名义 128 次的离线难度估计、每题 16 次的 rubric-reward GRPO 与三轮 Reasoning Cache 训练连接起来；FineProofs-RL 发布题目、rubric 和分数数组，但不发布产生这些分数的证明文本或逐次评分意见。
why: The work makes rollout budgeting, curriculum selection, judgment-based proof rewards, and train/test-time scaffold coupling explicit for a small open model. It also demonstrates that score populations can support prompt selection and RL without constituting a reusable trace corpus.
inclusion_reason: QED-Nano connects offline rollout-population statistics, rubric-based outcome reward, curriculum selection, online rollout groups, multi-turn Reasoning-Cache training, and high-budget test-time scaffolds. It is especially relevant to this track because the release makes clear what is reusable: prompts, rubrics, and score arrays, but not the corresponding proof trajectories or grader feedback.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Olympiad-level natural-language theorem proving combines long-horizon generation, sparse outcome feedback, and unusually expensive evaluation. The strongest systems often depend on undisclosed models, data mixtures, judges, and inference scaffolds. QED-Nano asks a narrower reproducible question: can a 4B open model be post-trained to write difficult proofs, and can additional reasoning be organized across training-time rollouts and test-time refinement rather than hidden inside a proprietary pipeline?

For a reasoning-data atlas, the main issue is not the headline model score. It is the relationship among four different objects: proof demonstrations used for SFT, a prompt corpus annotated with rollout-score populations, online RL samples graded by a learned judge, and multi-turn textual states used by Reasoning Cache. These objects have different generators, budgets, retention rules, and reuse boundaries. Treating them as one generic “proof dataset” would hide the feedback contract and overstate what was released.

FineProofs-RL makes this distinction concrete. Its 5,227 train rows contain Olympiad-style problem text, a coarse source label, a problem-specific rubric, arrays of scalar scores and normalized rewards, and summary statistics. They do not contain the Qwen3 proof attempts used to estimate difficulty, the online QED-Nano policy rollouts used for GRPO, or GPT-OSS-20B’s per-proof assessments. The release is therefore a prompt/rubric/score-population dataset, not a corpus of raw proof trajectories.

The work belongs in Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data because rollout budgets and selection rules shape both the training curriculum and the inference scaffold. Offline difficulty estimation is nominally based on 128 attempts per problem; online RL uses 16 attempts per problem in 64-prompt batches; Reasoning Cache performs three summarize-and-refine turns during training; and some evaluation scaffolds use roughly two million tokens per problem. These numbers are not interchangeable, and benchmark performance cannot establish the quality or completeness of any one data object.

Olympiad 级自然语言定理证明同时具有长程生成、稀疏 outcome feedback 与高昂评估成本。能力最强的系统往往依赖未披露的模型、数据混合、judge 与 inference scaffold。QED-Nano 提出一个更窄、也更便于复核的问题：能否通过后训练让一个开放的 4B 模型撰写困难证明，并把额外推理显式组织为训练时 rollout 与测试时迭代，而不是隐藏在专有流程中？

对推理数据图谱而言，关键并不是模型榜单分数，而是四类对象之间的关系：用于 SFT 的证明 demonstrations、带 rollout 分数总体统计的题目语料、由 learned judge 打分的在线 RL 样本，以及 Reasoning Cache 使用的多轮文本状态。这些对象的生成器、预算、保留规则和复用边界不同。若把它们统称为一个“proof dataset”，就会掩盖反馈契约并夸大发布范围。

FineProofs-RL 使这一区分变得具体。其 5,227 条 train 记录包含 Olympiad 风格题目文本、粗粒度来源标签、题目级 rubric、scalar score 与 normalized reward 数组，以及汇总统计；但不包含用于估计难度的 Qwen3 证明尝试、用于 GRPO 的在线 QED-Nano policy rollouts，也不包含 GPT-OSS-20B 针对每份证明的评语。因此，该发布是题目、rubric 与分数总体数据，而不是原始证明轨迹语料。

本工作归入 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，因为 rollout 预算和筛选规则同时塑造训练 curriculum 与 inference scaffold。离线难度估计名义上每题采样 128 次；在线 RL 每题采样 16 次并以 64 题组成 batch；Reasoning Cache 在训练时执行三轮总结与改进；部分评估 scaffold 每题使用约两百万 token。这些数字不能相互替代，benchmark 表现也不能证明任何单一数据对象的质量或完整性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
QED-Nano combines three post-training stages. First, DeepSeek-Math-V2 supplies long natural-language proof traces for a separate FineProofs-SFT release and QED-Nano-SFT initialization. Second, the model is optimized with asynchronous streaming GRPO using problem-specific rubric rewards on filtered FineProofs-RL prompts. Third, Reasoning Cache turns one very long proof attempt into a sequence of partial attempts and compact textual state summaries, allowing the policy to continue from an explicit account of progress.

The reusable FineProofs-RL record is deliberately smaller than that pipeline. Each row has eight fields: problem, source, rubrics, scores, rewards, num_rewards, reward_mean, and reward_std. The pinned release contains 5,227 unique rows in one train split, with 3,794 labeled aops and 1,433 labeled olympiads. Every released reward equals its integer score divided by seven. No proof, reasoning, message, grader-error, or assessment-text field is present.

The feedback contract is judgment-based outcome reward. Gemini 3 Pro writes a 0-7 rubric with positive checkpoints, zero-credit conditions, and deductions for each problem. GPT-OSS-20B with medium reasoning reads a completed natural-language proof and the rubric, then assigns one integer score. This signal is richer than a bare correct/incorrect label at the problem level, but it remains one scalar outcome for a full proof; the released rubric is not a sequence of verified step labels, and the judge is not a formal proof checker.

The central rollout distinction is between offline annotation and online optimization. Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 generates a nominal 128-attempt population to estimate prompt difficulty. The released arrays preserve those scalar outcomes, although 453 rows have only 62-127 values and one row has 256. Online GRPO instead samples 16 current-policy proofs for each prompt; 64 prompts form a 1,024-sample batch. Reasoning Cache adds three state-summary cycles during training. At test time, the paper compares single-turn generation with several much larger iterative scaffolds.

The contribution is therefore a coupled recipe rather than one monolithic trace release: SFT proof distillation initializes style, score-population statistics define a curriculum, rubric judgments supply RL rewards, textual cache states structure iterative reasoning, and high-budget inference explores further refinements. The audit boundary is equally important: FineProofs-RL exposes the prompts, rubrics, and scalar populations but not the generations or proof-specific feedback needed to reconstruct those populations.

QED-Nano 组合了三个后训练阶段。第一阶段由 DeepSeek-Math-V2 提供长篇自然语言证明轨迹，形成独立的 FineProofs-SFT 发布并用于初始化 QED-Nano-SFT。第二阶段在筛选后的 FineProofs-RL 题目上，以题目特定的 rubric reward 进行 asynchronous streaming GRPO。第三阶段的 Reasoning Cache 把一次极长证明尝试改写为若干轮局部尝试与紧凑文本状态摘要，使 policy 能依据显式的进展记录继续推理。

可复用的 FineProofs-RL 记录比完整流程小得多。每条记录只有八个字段：problem、source、rubrics、scores、rewards、num_rewards、reward_mean 与 reward_std。固定版本包含 5,227 条唯一记录，全部位于一个 train split，其中 3,794 条标为 aops，1,433 条标为 olympiads。每个已发布 reward 都等于相应整数 score 除以七。数据中没有 proof、reasoning、message、grader error 或 assessment text 字段。

其反馈契约是基于判断的 outcome reward。Gemini 3 Pro 针对每道题生成一份 0-7 分 rubric，其中包含正向检查点、零分条件和扣分项。GPT-OSS-20B 以 medium reasoning 阅读完整自然语言证明和 rubric，再给出一个整数分数。与题目级二值正确性相比，该信号包含更多结构，但对完整证明而言仍只是一个 scalar outcome；发布的 rubric 不是经过验证的逐步标签序列，judge 也不是 formal proof checker。

核心的 rollout 区分在于离线标注与在线优化。Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 名义上为每题生成 128 次尝试，以估计题目难度。发布数组保留了这些尝试的标量结果，但有 453 条记录只含 62-127 个值，另有一条含 256 个值。在线 GRPO 则为每个 prompt 采样 16 个当前 policy 的证明；64 个 prompt 构成 1,024 个样本的 batch。Reasoning Cache 在训练中增加三轮状态摘要。测试时，论文比较单轮生成与多种预算大得多的迭代 scaffold。

因此，该贡献是一套相互耦合的配方，而不是单一、完整的 trace release：SFT proof distillation 初始化证明风格，分数总体统计定义 curriculum，rubric judgment 提供 RL reward，文本 cache state 组织迭代推理，高预算 inference 进一步探索改进。相应的审计边界同样重要：FineProofs-RL 暴露题目、rubric 和标量总体，却不暴露重建这些总体所需的生成文本与证明特定反馈。

title: Method
方法
html:
The prompt pool begins with text-only Olympiad-style problems from AI-MO/aops and AI-MO/olympiads. The construction removes items that depend on images, are trivial or ill-posed, are very short or purely computational, or come from easier contests. GPT-5-Nano supplies an additional quality pass. All 2025 competition problems are excluded, and prompts are fuzzy-matched against IMO-ProofBench and ProofBench before exact problem-text deduplication. The release does not include the fuzzy-match threshold, candidate pairs, decision log, or rejected-prompt manifest.

Gemini 3 Pro then creates a task-specific 0-7 grading scheme. The rubric expresses checkpoints that should earn credit, conditions that should receive zero credit, and deductions. For offline difficulty annotation, Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 generates nominally 128 independent proof attempts per problem, and GPT-OSS-20B-medium grades each attempt. The retained FineProofs-RL row stores the rubric, score array, score/7 reward array, count, mean, and standard deviation, but drops every proof attempt and every proof-specific grading explanation.

The pinned parquet contains 5,227 rows. Direct inspection found 4,773 rows with exactly 128 scores, 453 with 62-127, and one with 256. More specifically, the shorter counts range from 62 to 127 and are concentrated at 126-127. All rows have matching num_rewards, score-list length, and reward-list length; no field is null, all rewards match score/7, and recomputed means agree within 1e-6. These integrity checks validate the stored arrays, not the mathematical validity of the unseen proofs.

Curriculum selection separates the offline population from online RL. The paper removes problems on which the base model has pass@1 at least 0.7 and problems with no successful difficulty rollout. The FineProofs-RL card additionally specifies reward mean at most 0.7 and reward standard deviation above 0.08. Retained prompts can still have zero-score attempts, but all-failure prompts are excluded. The reason for non-128 rows and the single 256-row population is undisclosed.

Online training uses asynchronous streaming GRPO. For each selected problem, the current policy generates 16 long proofs. A batch contains 64 problems and therefore 1,024 samples. GPT-OSS-20B-medium assigns the full-proof rubric score. The reported optimizer allows at most five gradient steps of off-policy lag, uses entropy coefficient 0.0001, constant learning rate 1e-6, and no KL regularization. Actor temperature is 0.8. Released configs cap generation at 49,152 tokens; the paper describes the response limit as roughly 50,000 tokens.

Reasoning Cache changes the rollout substrate. During training, a frozen Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 summarizer compresses partial proof progress into a textual state. The next rollout conditions on the original problem plus that summary, and the released configuration uses three reasoning/summarization cycles. Sixteen candidate proofs are sampled from each cache state before rollouts are subsampled for updates. The summaries and state-aligned proof texts are not part of FineProofs-RL.

The preceding SFT branch is separate. DeepSeek-Math-V2 generates 7,500 proofs over about 4,300 distinct problems for FineProofs-SFT. Structural filtering retains outputs with closed reasoning and proof sections, including some low-scoring or incorrect proofs. This stage teaches proof-writing form but also produces length explosion, repetition, and meandering; early RL from a verbose checkpoint reportedly suffers roughly 60% overflow or truncation.

The model card reports 150 optimization steps, 12 nodes with eight H100 GPUs each across seven generator, four trainer, and one grader node, four days, and 9,216 H100-hours. Test sampling uses top-p 0.95 and top-k 20; the grader uses temperature 1.0 with medium reasoning, and the cache summarizer uses temperature 0.7. At evaluation time, Reasoning Cache, Self-Check, Nomos, RSA, and DeepSeekMath-style scaffolds expand inference beyond a single proof; the largest reported RSA setting averages about 2.05 million tokens per problem.

题目池首先收集 AI-MO/aops 与 AI-MO/olympiads 中的纯文本 Olympiad 风格问题。构建流程排除依赖图片、过于简单、表述不良、过短、纯计算或来自较容易竞赛的条目，并使用 GPT-5-Nano 再做一轮质量筛选。所有 2025 年竞赛题均被排除，题目还会与 IMO-ProofBench 和 ProofBench 做模糊匹配，之后再按题目文本精确去重。发布中没有 fuzzy-match threshold、candidate pairs、decision log 或 rejected-prompt manifest。

随后，Gemini 3 Pro 为每道题生成一份 0-7 分的特定评分方案。rubric 描述应获得分数的检查点、应记零分的条件和扣分项。在离线难度标注阶段，Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 名义上为每题独立生成 128 个证明尝试，GPT-OSS-20B-medium 对每次尝试评分。FineProofs-RL 最终记录保留 rubric、score 数组、score/7 reward 数组、数量、均值和标准差，但丢弃全部证明尝试及每份证明对应的评分解释。

固定版本 parquet 包含 5,227 条记录。直接检查发现，4,773 条恰有 128 个分数，453 条有 62-127 个分数，另有一条含 256 个分数；较短数组的长度从 62 到 127，且主要集中在 126-127。所有记录的 num_rewards、score list 长度与 reward list 长度一致；各字段均无 null，reward 全部等于 score/7，重新计算的均值在 1e-6 容差内一致。这些完整性检查只能验证已存储数组，不能验证不可见证明的数学正确性。

curriculum selection 将离线总体与在线 RL 区分开来。论文排除 base model pass@1 不低于 0.7 的问题，以及在难度 rollouts 中从未成功的问题。FineProofs-RL card 还给出 reward mean 不高于 0.7、reward standard deviation 高于 0.08 的条件。保留题目仍可能含零分尝试，但全失败题目被排除。非 128 条记录和唯一 256 条记录出现的原因未披露。

在线训练采用 asynchronous streaming GRPO。对每道入选题目，当前 policy 生成 16 份长证明；一个 batch 含 64 道题，因此共有 1,024 个样本。GPT-OSS-20B-medium 按完整证明给出 rubric score。论文报告的 optimizer 最多允许五个 gradient step 的 off-policy lag，entropy coefficient 为 0.0001，constant learning rate 为 1e-6，且不使用 KL regularization。actor temperature 为 0.8。发布配置把 generation 上限设为 49,152 token，论文则将最大 response length 约述为 50,000 token。

Reasoning Cache 改变了 rollout substrate。训练时，一个冻结的 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 summarizer 把局部证明进展压缩为文本状态。下一轮 rollout 以原题和该摘要为条件，发布配置使用三轮 reasoning/summarization cycle。每个 cache state 采样 16 个候选证明，再对 rollouts 子采样用于更新。对应摘要和与 state 对齐的证明文本均不在 FineProofs-RL 中。

前置 SFT 分支是独立对象。DeepSeek-Math-V2 为 FineProofs-SFT 在约 4,300 道不同题目上生成 7,500 份证明。结构筛选保留含闭合 reasoning 与 proof 区段的输出，其中包括部分低分或错误证明。该阶段教授证明写作形式，但也导致长度膨胀、重复与绕行；从冗长 checkpoint 开始的早期 RL 据报约有 60% 的 overflow 或 truncation。

model card 报告训练执行 150 个 optimization step，使用 12 个节点、每节点 8 张 H100，其中包括 7 个 generator node、4 个 trainer node 和 1 个 grader node，共四天、9,216 H100-hours。测试采样使用 top-p 0.95 与 top-k 20；grader 使用 temperature 1.0 和 medium reasoning，cache summarizer 使用 temperature 0.7。评估时，Reasoning Cache、Self-Check、Nomos、RSA 与 DeepSeekMath-style scaffolds 把 inference 扩展到单次证明之外；最大 RSA 设置平均每题约使用 205 万 token。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence about the release comes from the artifact itself. At revision 61c9ade2e04ab4ee7e257434e0826cb9b737f63e, FineProofs-RL exposes one 5,227-row train parquet with exactly eight columns. Direct inspection found 5,227 unique non-empty problem strings, zero nulls, source counts of 3,794 aops and 1,433 olympiads, score range 0-7, reward range 0-1, no score/reward normalization mismatches, and no count or mean inconsistencies at the stated tolerance. It also confirmed the absence of proof, reasoning, assessment, error, or trajectory fields.

The paper and pinned configs support the budget distinctions. Offline difficulty scoring uses Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and nominally 128 judged attempts per problem. Online RL uses 16 current-policy attempts for each of 64 prompts, or 1,024 samples per batch, with generations capped at 49,152 tokens in code and rounded to about 50,000 in the paper. Reasoning-Cache training uses three refinement cycles. FineProofs-RL-test is a separate repository with 128 rows in a test split, not a hidden split of the main 5,227-row release.

The authors also validate the judge rather than presenting it as infallible. GPT-OSS-20B-medium is selected through grading benchmarks and a strict ProofBench-style prompt. The paper reports that providing a reference proof did not improve the chosen in-distribution advantage measure, so it was omitted. Human comparison nevertheless finds that the automated grader can be more generous, with a substantial mismatch on IMO 2025 Q2. This evidence supports using the signal as a learned rubric judge, not relabeling it as formal correctness.

The experimental results show that the recipe can train a small model and that iterative scaffolds can raise proof-generation performance. They also show failure behavior: SFT can produce length explosion and repetition, and early RL can spend much of its budget on truncated outputs. Test-time comparisons are highly compute-sensitive. Table 2 reports approximately 93,690 average tokens for a single turn and 2,045,764 for RSA, so gains mix model ability, scaffold design, and additional sampling budget.

What the evidence does not establish is equally important. Because no underlying proof attempts or grader assessments are released with the score arrays, no external reader can verify whether a particular 0-7 score is mathematically justified, analyze false positives and false negatives at the attempt level, or reconstruct why a row has fewer than 128 or as many as 256 outcomes. Integrity of the stored statistics is not evidence of proof validity, judge calibration, unbiased curriculum selection, or complete trace release.

The appropriate evidence conclusion is therefore limited: citation identity, official artifact ownership, row schema, counts, top-level release declarations, rollout settings, and the reported training/evaluation procedure are well supported. Reproducibility of individual rewards, exact decontamination decisions, upstream rights, and raw trajectory reuse remain partial.

关于发布内容，最强证据来自 artifact 本身。在 revision 61c9ade2e04ab4ee7e257434e0826cb9b737f63e 上，FineProofs-RL 公开一个含 5,227 条 train 记录、恰好八列的 parquet。直接检查发现 5,227 个唯一且非空的题目字符串，各列均无 null，来源计数为 3,794 条 aops 与 1,433 条 olympiads；score 范围为 0-7，reward 范围为 0-1，没有 score/reward 归一化不一致，也没有在指定容差下的计数或均值不一致。检查同时确认 proof、reasoning、assessment、error 与 trajectory 字段均不存在。

论文与固定版本配置支持不同预算之间的区分。离线难度评分使用 Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507，名义上每题有 128 次由 judge 评分的尝试。在线 RL 对 64 个 prompt 各使用 16 次当前 policy 尝试，即每个 batch 共 1,024 个样本；代码中的生成上限为 49,152 token，论文约述为 50,000。Reasoning-Cache 训练使用三轮 refinement。FineProofs-RL-test 是另一个 repository，其中 test split 有 128 条记录，并不是主发布 5,227 条记录中的隐藏 split。

作者还对 judge 做了验证，而没有把它描述为绝对正确。GPT-OSS-20B-medium 是根据 grading benchmarks 与严格的 ProofBench-style prompt 选定的。论文报告，加入 reference proof 并未提升其采用的 in-distribution advantage 指标，因此最终未提供 reference proof。尽管如此，人工对比仍发现 automated grader 有时更宽松，并在 IMO 2025 Q2 上出现明显不一致。这些证据支持把该信号视为 learned rubric judge，而不能重新命名为 formal correctness。

实验结果说明，该配方可以训练小模型，迭代 scaffold 也可以提升 proof-generation 表现。实验同样暴露失败行为：SFT 可能导致长度膨胀和重复，早期 RL 可能把大量预算消耗在被截断输出上。测试时比较高度依赖计算预算。表 2 报告单轮平均约 93,690 token，而 RSA 为 2,045,764 token，因此收益混合了模型能力、scaffold 设计与额外采样预算。

证据未能证明的内容同样重要。由于分数数组没有配套发布原始证明尝试或 grader assessment，外部读者无法判断某个 0-7 分是否在数学上合理，无法逐尝试分析 false positive 与 false negative，也无法重建为何某条记录少于 128 个结果或多达 256 个结果。已存储统计量的完整性并不等于证明有效性、judge calibration、无偏 curriculum selection 或完整 trace release。

因此，合理的证据结论是有限的：论文身份、官方 artifact 归属、记录 schema、计数、顶层发布声明、rollout 设置以及论文报告的训练评估流程均有充分支持；单个 reward 的可复现性、精确去污染决策、上游权利与原始轨迹复用仍是 partial。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
QED-Nano’s novelty for this atlas is the explicit coupling of rollout statistics, online outcome-reward RL, textual state compression, and test-time scaling in one open small-model pipeline. The individual ingredients are not wholly new: proof distillation, group-based RL, rubric judging, iterative refinement, and inference-time sampling all have precedents. The useful contribution is that the paper and official artifacts expose enough settings to distinguish their roles and budgets rather than collapsing them into one “more reasoning” intervention.

FineProofs-RL occupies an unusual middle ground between a prompt release and a trace release. It preserves one problem-specific rubric plus the entire scalar score population used to characterize difficulty. This supports distributional questions that a single pass rate would hide. At the same time, absence of the corresponding proofs means it offers substantially less evidence than a candidate-level rollout corpus. The score arrays reveal how many outcomes occurred and their values, but not what behavior earned them.

The rubric contract is also more structured than ordinary answer matching. Gemini 3 Pro supplies problem-specific checkpoints, zero-credit conditions, and deductions, and GPT-OSS-20B applies them to a full natural-language proof. Yet this should not be confused with process supervision: no intermediate proof step is independently checked or released with a label. A 0-7 outcome score may reflect several rubric dimensions without providing step-localized supervision.

Reasoning Cache contributes a state representation for long proof search. Instead of restarting every long attempt from the problem alone, it summarizes partial progress and conditions the next attempt on that summary. During training the paper uses a frozen Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 summarizer and three cycles; at test time the same QED-Nano family can be used within iterative scaffolds. This connects training-time data organization to inference-time computation, but it does not demonstrate that the summary is a lossless proof state.

The release is unusually informative about a negative boundary. FineProofs-SFT contains proof text, while FineProofs-RL does not. The RL dataset card discusses DeepSeek-Math-V2 generation and SFT as pipeline context, but its actual parquet schema contains only prompts, rubrics, score arrays, and statistics. Reading the prose without inspecting the schema could incorrectly turn a statistical reward artifact into a claimed raw-trace release.

The work should therefore be compared on disclosure and experimental contract, not through promotional rankings. Its reported proof scores support the feasibility of the recipe under the stated compute and judges. They do not prove that the released prompts are representative, that the rubric judge is calibrated, that score arrays are sufficient for reuse, or that larger test-time budgets improve the underlying data.

对本图谱而言，QED-Nano 的新意在于：它在一个开放小模型流程中显式连接 rollout 统计、在线 outcome-reward RL、文本状态压缩与 test-time scaling。各个组件并非全新；proof distillation、group-based RL、rubric judging、迭代改进与 inference-time sampling 都有既有工作。真正有用的贡献是论文和官方 artifacts 披露了足够多的设置，使读者能区分各组件的角色与预算，而不是把它们合并为一种笼统的“更多推理”干预。

FineProofs-RL 位于 prompt release 与 trace release 之间一个不常见的中间位置。它为每道题保留一份特定 rubric，并保留用于描述难度的完整 scalar score population，因此能支持单一 pass rate 无法呈现的分布问题。但由于相应证明缺失，其证据远少于 candidate-level rollout corpus。分数数组只能说明结果数量和值，不能说明什么行为获得了这些分数。

rubric 契约也比普通答案匹配更有结构。Gemini 3 Pro 提供题目特定的检查点、零分条件与扣分项，GPT-OSS-20B 将其应用于一份完整自然语言证明。但这不应与 process supervision 混淆：没有任何中间证明步骤被独立检查，也没有带标签发布。0-7 分 outcome score 可以综合多个 rubric 维度，却不提供 step-localized supervision。

Reasoning Cache 为长证明搜索引入一种状态表示。它不是每次都只从原题重新开始长尝试，而是总结局部进展，并让下一次尝试以该摘要为条件。训练时，论文使用冻结的 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 summarizer 与三轮循环；测试时，同一 QED-Nano 系列可被置于迭代 scaffold 中。该设计连接训练时数据组织与测试时计算，但并未证明摘要是无损的 proof state。

该发布还清楚揭示了一个负向边界。FineProofs-SFT 含证明文本，FineProofs-RL 则没有。RL dataset card 把 DeepSeek-Math-V2 生成和 SFT 作为流程背景讨论，但实际 parquet schema 只有题目、rubric、分数数组与统计量。若只读说明而不检查 schema，可能会错误地把统计型 reward artifact 描述成 raw trace release。

因此，应根据披露程度与实验契约比较本工作，而不是依据宣传式排名。论文报告的 proof score 支持该配方在指定算力和 judges 下的可行性，但不能证明发布题目具有代表性、rubric judge 已校准、分数数组足以支持复用，或更大的测试预算会改善底层数据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The main release limitation is the missing candidate text. FineProofs-RL stores 5,227 prompts, rubrics, and score populations but none of the proof attempts that received those scores. Successful and failed generations are both unavailable. Per-attempt GPT-OSS-20B assessments, extracted errors, grader tokens, expanded prompt inputs, and judge rationales are also absent. A user cannot recreate a score, audit mathematical content, study judge mistakes, or train on the hidden proofs from this dataset.

The nominal offline budget has unexplained exceptions. Of 5,227 rows, 4,773 contain 128 scores, 453 contain 62-127, and one contains 256. Counts and arrays are internally consistent, but neither the paper nor the dataset card explains interruption, retry, duplication, or aggregation behavior. Users should preserve the actual list length and must not assume a fixed 128 candidates per row.

Curriculum filtering changes the visible problem distribution. The online pipeline removes very easy prompts and all prompts with zero successful difficulty rollouts. This retains some failed attempts inside mixed-success score arrays but eliminates the hardest all-failure population. The paper does not release the pre-filter corpus, accepted/rejected manifest, or counterfactual training results needed to measure this selection effect.

The verifier is a learned judge. GPT-OSS-20B-medium may give partial credit and apply a detailed rubric, but it does not formally prove or refute the submitted argument. The paper’s human comparison finds generosity and a substantial discrepancy on IMO 2025 Q2. False acceptance, false rejection, style preference, rubric ambiguity, and reward gaming remain possible. No versioned calibration set, refresh policy, attempt-level confidence, or adversarial judge audit is released.

Source and decontamination lineage is coarse. Each row is labeled only aops or olympiads; stable source URLs, competition IDs, year metadata, and item-level rights are absent. The paper reports exclusion of 2025 competition problems, fuzzy matching against IMO-ProofBench and ProofBench, and exact deduplication, but not thresholds, candidate pairs, reviewer decisions, or overlap logs. Model-pretraining contamination is not resolved by prompt-level filtering.

Split semantics require care. The main FineProofs-RL repository has one 5,227-row train split and no internal validation or test split. FineProofs-RL-test is a separate official dataset repository with a 128-row test split loaded by the configs. Users must not merge those identities or infer a random split. No released manifest documents how either set relates to original source competitions at the item level.

Licensing remains partial. FineProofs-RL declares Apache 2.0, and the code and model card also use Apache-2.0; the arXiv paper is CC BY 4.0. Those top-level declarations do not by themselves establish rights to scraped AoPS posts, competition problem statements or solutions, or model-generated derivatives. The checked AI-MO/aops and AI-MO/olympiads cards do not expose a clear repository-level license. Redistribution and production use therefore require source-item rights review.

Reproduction requires immutable pins. The checked evidence uses code commit 02a4699ed380f8e980a8d44c755b8bfd4e310718, FineProofs-RL revision 61c9ade2e04ab4ee7e257434e0826cb9b737f63e, FineProofs-RL-test revision f2f55ba4a125aa0cb2fde0e3e75df9ce8971774a, and QED-Nano model revision 1016ddef8dd40552b97216ce34e3fece2fffa2bb. The repository has no immutable release tag, so unpinned links may drift.

The training and inference results are budget-sensitive. SFT creates repetition and excessive length, while early RL reportedly truncates or overflows around 60% of attempts. Reasoning Cache summaries can omit necessary proof state or preserve an incorrect plan. At test time, RSA averages about 2.05 million tokens per problem versus roughly 93.7 thousand for a single turn. Accuracy differences therefore cannot be attributed solely to better post-training data or model parameters.

Unknowns that materially block full audit are the raw offline and online proofs, state-aligned Reasoning-Cache traces and summaries, proof-specific judge output, non-128 count explanation, exact rejected-prompt and decontamination logs, row-level provenance, upstream rights, peer-reviewed venue, and tagged paper-exact release. These gaps justify status: partial and L4 bilingual readiness rather than a higher workflow state.

最主要的发布限制是 candidate text 缺失。FineProofs-RL 存储 5,227 个题目、rubric 与分数总体，却不含任何获得这些分数的证明尝试；成功与失败生成均不可见。逐尝试的 GPT-OSS-20B assessment、提取错误、grader token、展开后的 prompt input 与 judge rationale 也未发布。用户无法用该数据重现某个分数、审计数学内容、研究 judge 错误，或训练于隐藏的证明。

名义离线预算存在未解释的例外。在 5,227 条记录中，4,773 条含 128 个分数，453 条含 62-127 个分数，另有一条含 256 个分数。计数与数组内部一致，但论文和 dataset card 都没有解释 interruption、retry、duplication 或 aggregation 行为。复用者应保留实际 list length，不能假设每条记录固定有 128 个 candidate。

curriculum filtering 改变了可见题目分布。在线流程排除很容易的 prompt，也排除在难度 rollouts 中从未成功的全部 prompt。这样会在混合成功率数组中保留部分失败尝试，却删除最难的全失败总体。论文没有发布筛选前语料、accepted/rejected manifest 或衡量选择效应所需的反事实训练结果。

verifier 是 learned judge。GPT-OSS-20B-medium 可以给部分分并应用细致 rubric，但不能形式化证明或否定输入论证。论文中的人工对比发现它有时更宽松，并在 IMO 2025 Q2 上出现明显不一致。false acceptance、false rejection、风格偏好、rubric 歧义与 reward gaming 仍可能发生。发布中没有版本化 calibration set、refresh policy、逐尝试置信度或 adversarial judge audit。

来源与去污染谱系较粗。每条记录只有 aops 或 olympiads 标签，缺少稳定来源 URL、竞赛 ID、年份元数据和 item-level rights。论文报告排除 2025 年竞赛题、与 IMO-ProofBench 和 ProofBench 做 fuzzy matching，并进行 exact deduplication，但没有披露 threshold、candidate pairs、reviewer decisions 或 overlap logs。prompt-level filtering 也不能解决模型预训练污染。

split 语义需要谨慎处理。主 FineProofs-RL repository 只有一个 5,227 条记录的 train split，没有内部 validation 或 test split。FineProofs-RL-test 是另一个官方 dataset repository，包含配置加载的 128 条 test 记录。用户不能混合这两个身份，也不能自行推断随机 split。没有发布 manifest 在 item level 说明两者与原始竞赛来源的关系。

许可信息仍不完整。FineProofs-RL 声明 Apache 2.0，代码和 model card 也使用 Apache-2.0，arXiv 论文为 CC BY 4.0。但这些顶层声明本身不能确立对抓取的 AoPS 帖子、竞赛题目或解答、以及模型生成衍生物的权利。已检查的 AI-MO/aops 与 AI-MO/olympiads cards 没有明确 repository-level license。因此，再分发与生产使用需要单独审查 source-item rights。

复现还需要不可变版本固定。本卡证据使用 code commit 02a4699ed380f8e980a8d44c755b8bfd4e310718、FineProofs-RL revision 61c9ade2e04ab4ee7e257434e0826cb9b737f63e、FineProofs-RL-test revision f2f55ba4a125aa0cb2fde0e3e75df9ce8971774a 与 QED-Nano model revision 1016ddef8dd40552b97216ce34e3fece2fffa2bb。repository 没有 immutable release tag，未固定链接可能发生漂移。

训练和 inference 结果高度依赖预算。SFT 导致重复与长度过长，早期 RL 据报约 60% 尝试发生 truncation 或 overflow。Reasoning Cache 摘要可能遗漏必要 proof state，也可能保留错误计划。测试时，RSA 平均每题约 205 万 token，而单轮约 9.37 万 token。因此，准确率差异不能仅归因于更好的后训练数据或模型参数。

会实质阻碍完整审计的 unknown 包括：原始离线与在线证明、与状态对齐的 Reasoning-Cache 轨迹及摘要、证明特定的 judge output、非 128 计数解释、完整 rejected-prompt 与 decontamination logs、行级 provenance、上游权利、同行评审 venue，以及带 tag 的 paper-exact release。这些缺口支持 status: partial 与 L4 双语待审状态，而不支持更高 workflow state。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, QED-Nano provides a useful budget ledger. A reuse study can keep four layers separate: nominally 128 offline Qwen3 attempts for difficulty statistics; 16 online QED-Nano rollouts per prompt for GRPO; three Reasoning-Cache refinement turns during training; and a test-time scaffold budget that can approach two million tokens. Reporting only “number of rollouts” would make these incomparable processes look equivalent.

FineProofs-RL can support prompt-level and statistical research without claiming access to hidden traces. Its released problem text, rubric, score population, count, mean, and standard deviation can be used to:

  • study curriculum rules under the observed difficulty and variance statistics;
  • stratify prompts for new rollout collection while retaining actual per-row list lengths;
  • compare newly generated proofs against the released problem-level rubrics using a separately documented judge;
  • audit how all-failure and very-easy filters reshape a training prompt distribution;
  • design richer releases that align each score with proof text, judge output, model revision, seed, and token budget.

The data is not ready-made SFT proof text, preference pairs, process labels, or reward-model training data. FineProofs-SFT is the separate proof-text artifact used for distillation and SFT. FineProofs-RL may seed a new RLVR-style experiment only if the reuser supplies a policy generator and a clearly specified rubric grader, records the resulting attempts, and rechecks judge calibration. A list of historical scalar scores cannot train the paper’s policy without the corresponding actions.

The construction recipe is also useful for controlled ablations. Researchers can compare problem selection with and without zero-success removal, fixed versus variable offline sample counts, binary versus 0-7 rubric outcomes, single-turn versus summarized-state rollouts, and matched-budget inference scaffolds. Each comparison should hold the model, prompt set, judge, maximum response length, temperature, and total generated tokens as constant as possible.

For verifier research, the paper offers a concrete learned-judge audit surface. New work can reproduce a human comparison, measure false acceptance and false rejection by score band, test robustness to verbosity and stylistic variation, and probe reward hacking against individual rubric clauses. Because attempt-level inputs and outputs are missing from FineProofs-RL, these studies require fresh generations; they cannot retrospectively validate the released scores.

For test-time compute research, report generated tokens, calls, parallel width, sequential depth, truncation, latency, and compute cost alongside proof scores. The approximately 93,690-token single-turn and 2,045,764-token RSA averages demonstrate why matched-budget comparisons are necessary. A scaffold gain under twenty times the generation budget is evidence about the combined system, not proof that the base model or training data alone improved.

Before reuse, pin the official revisions, keep FineProofs-RL and FineProofs-RL-test as separate repositories and splits, preserve source labels, review upstream rights, and publish any new proof/judge records under stable IDs. The appropriate reuse class is strong recipe and prompt/rubric/statistics reference; conditional research reuse; raw-trace analysis impossible without recollection; redistribution and production use pending source-rights review.

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 而言，QED-Nano 提供了一份有用的预算账本。复用研究应区分四层：名义上每题 128 次的离线 Qwen3 难度统计尝试；每个 prompt 16 次、用于 GRPO 的在线 QED-Nano rollout；训练中的三轮 Reasoning-Cache refinement；以及可接近两百万 token 的 test-time scaffold 预算。若只报告“rollout 数量”，就会把这些不可比较的过程写成同一对象。

FineProofs-RL 可以支持 prompt-level 与统计型研究，但不能宣称能访问隐藏 trace。发布的题目文本、rubric、score population、数量、均值和标准差可以用于：

  • 在已观察的难度与方差统计下研究 curriculum rule；
  • 在保留每条记录实际 list length 的前提下，为新 rollout collection 分层采样题目；
  • 使用另行记录的 judge，将新生成证明与发布的题目级 rubric 对照；
  • 审计全失败过滤与过易过滤如何改变训练 prompt 分布；
  • 设计更完整的发布，把每个 score 与 proof text、judge output、model revision、seed 和 token budget 对齐。

该数据不是现成的 SFT proof text、preference pair、process label 或 reward-model training data。FineProofs-SFT 才是用于 distillation 与 SFT 的独立证明文本 artifact。FineProofs-RL 只有在复用者提供 policy generator 和定义清楚的 rubric grader、记录新产生的尝试并重新检查 judge calibration 时，才能作为新 RLVR-style experiment 的题目来源。缺少对应 action 的历史 scalar score 列表无法训练论文中的 policy。

构建配方也适合受控 ablation。研究者可比较保留与排除零成功题目、固定与可变离线样本数、二值 outcome 与 0-7 rubric outcome、单轮 rollout 与摘要状态 rollout，以及预算匹配的 inference scaffolds。每项比较都应尽量固定模型、题目集合、judge、maximum response length、temperature 与总生成 token。

对 verifier 研究，论文提供了具体的 learned-judge audit surface。后续工作可重做人工对比，按 score band 衡量 false acceptance 与 false rejection，测试对冗长程度和写作风格变化的鲁棒性，并针对 rubric 条款探测 reward hacking。由于 FineProofs-RL 缺少逐尝试输入输出，这些研究必须重新生成证明，不能追溯验证已发布分数。

对 test-time compute 研究，应把生成 token、调用次数、并行宽度、顺序深度、truncation、latency 与计算成本和 proof score 一起报告。单轮约 93,690 token、RSA 约 2,045,764 token 的平均值说明为何必须做预算匹配比较。在约二十倍生成预算下得到的 scaffold 收益是组合系统的证据，不能证明 base model 或训练数据单独变好。

复用前，应固定官方 revisions，把 FineProofs-RL 与 FineProofs-RL-test 作为不同 repository 与 split 处理，保留来源标签，审查上游权利，并为所有新 proof/judge 记录发布稳定 ID。适当的复用等级是：强配方及题目、rubric、统计参考；有条件的研究复用；若不重新采集则无法进行原始 trace 分析；再分发与生产使用须等待 source-rights 审查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the three data branches separately: DeepSeek-Math-V2 proof text belongs to FineProofs-SFT, while FineProofs-RL contains 5,227 problems, rubrics, score arrays, and statistics but no proofs or grader assessments.
  • Keep the budgets distinct: nominally 128 offline Qwen3 attempts estimate difficulty; online GRPO uses 16 policy rollouts for each of 64 prompts, or 1,024 samples per batch; Reasoning Cache uses three training turns.
  • Inspect actual array lengths rather than assuming 128: 4,773 rows have 128 scores, 453 have 62-127, and one has 256; the release does not explain the exceptions.
  • Treat GPT-OSS-20B-medium as a learned rubric judge, not a formal verifier or process labeler; the paper documents human disagreement, and attempt-level inputs and assessments are not released.
  • Before reuse, pin code and Hugging Face revisions, keep the 5,227-row train release separate from the 128-row FineProofs-RL-test repository, and audit decontamination, upstream rights, filtering bias, and test-time token budgets.

• 应分别阅读三条数据分支：DeepSeek-Math-V2 生成的证明文本属于 FineProofs-SFT；FineProofs-RL 含 5,227 道题目、rubric、score array 与统计量，但没有证明或 grader assessment。
  • 必须区分不同预算：名义上每题 128 次的离线 Qwen3 尝试用于估计难度；在线 GRPO 对 64 个 prompt 各采样 16 个 policy rollout，即每个 batch 1,024 个样本；Reasoning Cache 使用三轮训练迭代。
  • 应检查实际 array length，而不能假设固定为 128：4,773 条记录含 128 个分数，453 条含 62-127 个，另有一条含 256 个；发布没有解释这些例外。
  • 应把 GPT-OSS-20B-medium 视为 learned rubric judge，而非 formal verifier 或 process labeler；论文记录了与人工判断的不一致，逐尝试输入和 assessment 也未发布。
  • 复用前应固定代码和 Hugging Face revisions，区分 5,227 条 train 发布与 128 条 FineProofs-RL-test repository，并审计 decontamination、上游权利、filtering bias 与 test-time token budget。

value.html: FineProofs-RL draws text-only Olympiad-style proof problems from AI-MO/aops and AI-MO/olympiads after filtering image-dependent, trivial, ill-posed, short, purely computational, easier-contest, 2025-competition, and benchmark-matched items. The pinned release contains 5,227 unique problems: 3,794 labeled aops and 1,433 labeled olympiads.

Training and evaluation use long natural-language proofs. A reusable FineProofs-RL row instead contains a problem, coarse source, problem-level rubric, arrays of integer scores and normalized rewards, their count, mean, and standard deviation. The corresponding proof text and grader assessment are not released.

Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 generates offline difficulty-estimation attempts; the current QED-Nano policy generates online GRPO and Reasoning-Cache proof rollouts. A frozen Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 snapshot summarizes partial progress during Reasoning-Cache training. DeepSeek-Math-V2 separately generates FineProofs-SFT proof traces for initialization.

Natural-language theorem proving without Lean or an external formal proof tool. Standard RL samples complete long proofs. Reasoning Cache alternates partial proof generation with a compact textual state summary, then conditions the next rollout on the original problem and that summary.

Gemini 3 Pro generates a 0-7 problem-specific grading scheme with checkpoints, zero-credit items, and deductions. GPT-OSS-20B with medium reasoning grades a completed proof against that scheme. FineProofs-RL stores integer scores and score/7 normalized rewards, but no proof-specific grader rationale.

A completed or truncated natural-language proof receives one rubric-based 0-7 outcome score from the learned judge. This is not a formal proof-checker predicate, and the paper documents disagreement with human evaluation.

DeepSeek-Math-V2 supplies SFT traces; Gemini 3 Pro generates problem-specific rubrics; GPT-OSS-20B-medium supplies proof grades; frozen Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 summarizes Reasoning-Cache state during training.

DeepSeek-Math-V2 generates separate SFT proof targets. Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 generates the offline difficulty population, and the evolving QED-Nano policy generates online proof rollouts from each selected prompt or Reasoning-Cache state.

Precompute difficulty from nominally 128 independently graded Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 attempts per problem. During online training, sample 16 proofs per problem for 64 prompts, yielding 1,024 samples, grade complete proofs with GPT-OSS-20B-medium, and update with asynchronous streaming GRPO. Reasoning-Cache training uses three summarize-and-refine cycles and subsamples state-conditioned rollouts for policy updates.

Offline annotation is nominally 128 attempts per problem. In the pinned FineProofs-RL release, 4,773 rows have 128 scores, 453 have 62-127, and one has 256. Online GRPO uses 16 rollouts per problem. Reasoning-Cache training uses three reasoning/summarization turns.

Actor temperature is 0.8; test sampling uses top-p 0.95 and top-k 20; the Reasoning-Cache summarizer uses temperature 0.7; and GPT-OSS-20B grading uses temperature 1.0 with medium reasoning, according to the pinned configs.

Remove image-dependent, trivial, ill-posed, very short, purely computational, and easier-contest items; apply GPT-5-Nano quality flags; exclude all 2025 competition problems; fuzzy-match against IMO-ProofBench and ProofBench; and exactly deduplicate released problem text. For online RL, the paper removes problems with base-model pass@1 at least 0.7 and problems with no successful rollout. The dataset card additionally states reward mean at most 0.7 and reward standard deviation above 0.08.

Released configs cap actor generations at 49,152 tokens, while the paper rounds the RL maximum response length to about 50,000. The model card reports 150 optimization steps, 64 prompts and 1,024 rollouts per batch, 12 eight-H100 nodes across generator, trainer, and grader roles, four days, and 9,216 H100-hours. Test-time scaffold evaluation scales to roughly two million tokens per problem.

Asynchronous streaming GRPO with at most five gradient steps of policy lag, entropy coefficient 0.0001, no KL regularization, constant learning rate 1e-6, and rubric-based outcome rewards. Reasoning Cache adds three-turn textual-state refinement during training; evaluation also covers Reasoning Cache, Self-Check, Nomos, RSA, and DeepSeekMath-style scaffolds.

The pinned FineProofs-RL train release has 5,227 non-null rows: 3,794 coarse aops sources and 1,433 coarse olympiads sources. It combines problem text, Gemini-generated rubrics, and GPT-OSS grades of Qwen3-4B-Thinking difficulty attempts; the attempt text is absent.

FineProofs-RL revision 61c9ade2e04ab4ee7e257434e0826cb9b737f63e exposes one 5,227-row train split. Code separately loads FineProofs-RL-test revision f2f55ba4a125aa0cb2fde0e3e75df9ce8971774a, which exposes a 128-row test split in a different dataset repository.

The paper excludes all 2025 competition problems and applies fuzzy string matching against IMO-ProofBench and ProofBench. The release card also reports exact deduplication. Match thresholds, candidate pairs, decisions, and row-level source manifests are not released.

items: FineProofs-RL releases no rollout proof text, including failed attempts, so its score arrays cannot be audited against mathematical content.
Per-rollout GPT-OSS assessments, error lists, and expanded judge inputs are absent; a problem-level rubric is not proof-specific feedback.
The nominal 128-attempt count is not universal: 453 rows have 62-127 grades and one row has 256, with no disclosed explanation.
Removing zero-success and very easy prompts narrows the online training distribution and discards the hardest all-failure population.
GPT-OSS-20B is a learned judge rather than a proof checker; the paper reports occasional generosity and a substantial error on IMO 2025 Q2.
The FineProofs-RL card mentions DeepSeek-Math-V2 proof generation and SFT context, but its parquet has no proof, reasoning, messages, or assessment fields. It is not a raw trace release.
SFT causes length explosion, repetition, and meandering; early RL from a verbose checkpoint has around 60 percent overflow or truncation.
Test-time results are budget-sensitive: Table 2 reports about 2.05 million average tokens for RSA versus about 93.7 thousand for a single turn.
Fuzzy-match logs, rejected-prompt manifests, per-row competition provenance, and upstream source licensing are unavailable.
No immutable GitHub release tag exists; reuse should pin the checked code, dataset, test-dataset, and model revisions.
